summary: OAuth1ConnectionMixin provides reusable connect/auth lifecycle for OAuth 1.0a providers. Handles token loading from store, migration from profile.auth fields, auto-authorization, and builds httpx.Client with authlib OAuth1Auth signing.

key_classes.name: OAuth1ConnectionMixin
key_classes.summary: Mixin class. Subclasses must set _spec and _base_url. connect() loads/migrates tokens and builds an authlib-signed httpx.Client. Requires authlib optional dependency.

key_functions.name: OAuth1ConnectionMixin.connect
key_functions.summary: Loads tokens from store, migrates from profile.auth, or triggers auto_authorize flow. Returns Self.

key_functions.name: OAuth1ConnectionMixin._build_client
key_functions.summary: Creates httpx.Client with authlib OAuth1Auth for request signing.
